items.title: `uv upgrade` should allow upgrading dependencies in extras or groups
items.reason: Exact match: a package declared only in a dependency group fails with the same 'was not found in project.dependencies' error. Tracks group and extras support for the same command; the dev group is a specific instance.

items.title: Allow `uv upgrade` to update optional and group dependencies
items.reason: Linked from astral-sh/uv#20783 by a maintainer. Extends selection and requirement rewriting to optional dependencies and dependency groups, including include-group. It predates this report and remains unmerged, despite the issue comment saying 'Fixed by'.

items.title: Add support for `--upgrade-group`
items.reason: Provides the existing alternative `uv lock --upgrade-group dev`, released in 0.11.4 before the reported 0.13.7. Upgrades direct group members in the lockfile within declared constraints; it does not add group support or constraint rewriting to `uv upgrade`.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv with authenticated gh across open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged PRs. Decomposed the report into group-only package rejection, unsupported --dev, and lockfile updates versus manifest constraint changes. Literal searches included uv upgrade, dependency-groups, project.dependencies, the exact not-found error, and unexpected argument --dev; conceptual searches used extras, groups, production dependencies, upgrade-package, and upgrade-group without ipython, platform, or version restrictions. Followed maintainer references to astral-sh/uv#20590 and inspected its comments and merge status; inspected merged astral-sh/uv#19738 and astral-sh/uv#18266 for historical scope and available functionality. General PR searches returned no hits; referenced PRs were inspected directly. Inspected astral-sh/uv#20782, which was centralized into astral-sh/uv#20783. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#20574 as the canonical match because it concerns indirect conflict constraints, and astral-sh/uv#19160 because it requests main-dependency selection for lock upgrades. Also inspected broader astral-sh/uv#6794 and the implemented lock-group request astral-sh/uv#13705. One additional lockfile/dev search was rate-limited. Checked current source, existing tests, documentation, and release notes.

type_reason: Open astral-sh/uv#20783 already tracks the same command rejecting dependencies outside project.dependencies with the same error; the dev-group reproduction fits that discussion. Its linked implementation, astral-sh/uv#20590, predates this report and is still open with no merge date. Current source and tests confirm the restriction, so the 'Fixed by' comment does not establish a released fix or regression. Duplicate classification takes precedence over independently assessing the missing capability.
summary: astral-sh/uv#20783 is the exact match, with support proposed in the still-open astral-sh/uv#20590. Merged astral-sh/uv#18266 provides an existing group-scoped lockfile upgrade command.
draft_response:
Group support for `uv upgrade` is tracked in astral-sh/uv#20783, with an open implementation in astral-sh/uv#20590. The current command only selects `project.dependencies` and edits constraints in `pyproject.toml`; it does not update `uv.lock`.

For the lockfile update you described, use `uv lock --upgrade-package ipython`. This works for dependencies in `dev` without `--dev`. To upgrade the whole group, use `uv lock --upgrade-group dev`. Both respect existing version constraints, so an exact pin still needs to be changed to permit a newer version.
